_comment: Explosives Cycler: up to 10 lists, cycled in this order. Lists after the 10th are ignored.
This file is overwritten by mod updates. To change the lists, copy it to lists-user.json in this folder and edit the copy: if lists-user.json exists, this file is not read at all.
Format: one key per line, one item per line, item = Plugin.esm|LocalHexID (as in LootMan). Items from plugins you do not have (DLC) are skipped.
List name: name_<language> by sLanguage from Fallout4.ini (name_en, name_ru, name_de ...), falls back to name_en.
The line is: List name Item x5. An empty list name shows the item alone.
Icons in a list name: [grenade], [mine], [molotov] (lowercase), e.g. [grenade][grenade]. Game notifications cannot show icons and drop them.
Reload in MCM: Explosives Cycler - Reload lists.
